title: MACD
goal: See how two averages can show a change in momentum.

objectives.text: Name the MACD line, the signal line and the bars.
Say what a cross may hint.
Know that MACD is late and can be wrong.

slides.text: MACD compares a fast EMA with a slow EMA. It shows if momentum grows or shrinks.
slides.title: Two averages

slides.text: The MACD line is the fast EMA minus the slow EMA. The fast one uses 12 candles. The slow one uses 26.
slides.title: The MACD line

slides.text: The signal line is a 9 candle average of the MACD line. The histogram is the bars. Each bar is the MACD line minus the signal line.
slides.title: Signal line and bars

demo.caption: Real Apple prices. See both lines and the bars.

slides.text: At times the MACD line crosses the signal line. The bars flip at zero. Some traders see a hint that momentum is changing.
slides.title: What it tries to tell you

slides.text: MACD uses old prices, so it is late. In a flat market it crosses a lot. Those false hints can fool you.
slides.title: Do not trust it alone

options.text: A fast EMA and a slow EMA

questions.explanation: MACD compares a fast EMA with a slow EMA.

questions.prompt: Match each part to its meaning.

pairs.definition: A 9 candle average of the MACD line
Bars for the gap between the two

questions.explanation: There are two lines. The histogram bars show the gap.

questions.prompt: The histogram bars show the gap between the two lines.
questions.explanation: Yes. Tall bars mean the two lines are far apart.

questions.prompt: The MACD line crosses the signal line. What may it hint?

options.text: The price will rise for sure

questions.explanation: A cross is a hint, not a promise. Momentum may be changing.

questions.prompt: MACD can give a false hint.
questions.explanation: Yes. In a flat market it crosses a lot and can fool you.
The usual MACD uses 12, 26 and 9. The 70 and 30 are for RSI.

questions.prompt: MACD is late, because it uses old prices.
questions.explanation: Yes. It trails the price. So it turns late.

questions.prompt: Turn on MACD. Keep the rest off.
questions.explanation: The MACD strip shows two lines and the bars.
